segments.t: Cinco minutos más tarde, alrededor de la lámpara encendida de la galería, Tessa, Evelyn y Owen se reúnen ante la caja de lata azul y de latón abierta, cada uno con un pequeño recuerdo de su semana inolvidable. Escuchemos primero la escena.
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe — both halves together!
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
And from Caleb and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Evelyn to add on top!
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
Look at Graham standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.
Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim — ready for the waxed linen!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
Repasemos ahora, frase por frase, qué guardan en la nueva cápsula.
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe — both halves together!
'¡Lo primero que entra en la lata es la receta COMPLETA del pastel de bayas y almendras: las dos mitades juntas!'
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
'¿¡La sellaste en plástico impermeable Y escribiste MIEL Y RALLADURA DE NARANJA en mayúsculas!?'
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
'¡Los reposteros del futuro, dentro de treinta veranos, se merecen cero manchas de tinta y cero cucharones de sopa!'
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
'Después, aquí tienen una copia limpia y firmada de nuestro Vals del Patio y del dúo a cuatro manos.'
And from Caleb and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
'Y de parte de Caleb y mía: ¡la pinza de abedul número nueve, firmada por detrás por todos!'
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Evelyn to add on top!
'¡Ay, miren lo que nuestro cartógrafo de la habitación Ocho acaba de mandar con Evelyn para poner encima!'
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
'Mientras tocábamos el piano, ¡nos dibujó a los veintiocho bajo los farolillos de la azotea!'
Look at Graham standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
'¡Miren a Graham junto a la puerta, haciendo como que no sonríe, en carboncillo!'
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.
'Mete en la esquina un sobrecito de hojas de menta secas del patio para que huela dulce.'
Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
'Dentro de treinta veranos, alguien levantará esta tapa y olerá a té cálido de verano.'
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim — ready for the waxed linen!
'Tapa bien encajada, cinta de tela blanca alrededor del borde: ¡lista para el lino encerado!'
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
'¡Llevémosla afuera, bajo los farolillos, mientras la tercera losa todavía espera!'
Escuchemos otra vez toda la escena, de principio a fin.
First into the tin goes the COMPLETE berry almond cake recipe — both halves together!
Did you seal it in waterproof plastic AND write HONEY AND ORANGE ZEST in capitals?!
Future bakers thirty summers from tonight deserve zero ink smudges and zero soup ladles!
Next, here is a clean signed copy of our Courtyard Waltz and four-hand duet.
And from Caleb and me: birch clothespin number nine, signed on the back by everyone!
Oh, look what our Room Eight mapmaker just sent in with Evelyn to add on top!
While we played piano, he sketched all twenty-eight of us under the rooftop lanterns!
Look at Graham standing by the doorway pretending not to smile in charcoal!
Tuck a small packet of dried courtyard mint leaves in the corner for a sweet smell.
Thirty summers from now, someone will lift this lid and smell warm summer tea.
Lid pressed down snug, white cloth tape around the rim — ready for the waxed linen!
Let us carry it out under the lanterns while the third stone is still waiting!
Una receta impermeable, una canción rescatada, la pinza número nueve y un retrato al carboncillo descansan a salvo dentro de la lata nueva. Nos vemos en el patio en la próxima escena.
See you next time!
